destination.name: Yamba
destination.tagline: A Clarence River mouth town known for the surf break at Angourie.
destination.description: Yamba is a fishing and tourism town at the mouth of the Clarence River, with eleven beaches within its postcode and a surf club formed in 1908, one of the oldest in the world. Angourie Point to the south is a National Surfing Reserve beside the freshwater Angourie Pools. Across the river, Iluka has a World Heritage littoral rainforest, and Maclean upriver bills itself as the Scottish Town. Whales pass Lovers Point Rock Wall between May and October.
whyVisit: Explore Iluka across the Clarence River
Spot tartan power poles in Maclean

goodToKnow.title: Two ways to Iluka
goodToKnow.detail: Iluka is reached by the shuttle ferry across the Clarence River from Yamba or by the motorway.

goodToKnow.title: Whale season
goodToKnow.detail: Between May and October whales can be seen passing Lovers Point Rock Wall at the northern tip of Pippi Beach.

goodToKnow.title: Check NPWS alerts for Iluka
goodToKnow.detail: Iluka Nature Reserve is open daily, but check NPWS alerts before visiting the rainforest.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Whales pass the headlands from May to October, so {months} are the months to come for the coast; beaches suit summer.
